title: Morphogen policy, version 1
description: The owner's rules, read only from the protected base branch. A card may narrow them, never widen them.

scope.description: Globs a card's scope must lie within.

protected.description: Globs no change may touch, whatever its card says (the judge, its rules, its workflows, its tests).

required_kpis.description: KPIs every card on this set must carry, with the loosest floor allowed.

allowed_kpis.description: Further KPIs a card may add (name and source). Absent: only the required ones.

stale_after.description: Verdicts served before the set is flagged stale.

alpha.description: One-sided significance level for each deciding KPI.
